summary: First-iteration end-to-end test of Qlub LA Market Intelligence Dashboard. All 8 backend API tests pass (health, auth login success/fail, 65 restaurants with full schema, 23 neighborhoods, VoC sync for 'Bestia' via Gemini googleSearch with sentiment summing to 100 and pain-point weighting, VoC sync with empty body using LA-wide default, VoC history with no _id leak). All frontend flows work: login screen renders terminal boot, wrong password shows error, correct password 'qlub2026' enters app-shell; all 5 sidebar nav items route to their pages; Overview KPI cards, LA density map, CTA cards (including cta-to-voc navigation) all render; ICP shows 6 attribute bento cards + persona + anti; Expo renders exactly 65 restaurant cards, search 'Bestia' filters to 1 card, modal opens/closes, 3 filter selects + export buttons present; VoC Sync Lock toggles from ON to OFF, running sync for 'Bestia' shows staged-banner (~20s via Gemini), Confirm promotes; Logout returns to login screen. No blocking issues found. Only minor console warnings from Recharts about container sizing during initial mount (harmless).

design_issues.screen: All pages with charts (Overview, Marketing Insights)
issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial mount — containers have no defined minWidth/minHeight. Visual result is fine but console is noisy. Recommend setting minWidth=0 or fixed height on chart wrappers.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Suppress Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings by giving chart containers explicit min dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 496 lines — acceptable but trending toward the 700-line split threshold if more endpoints are added. Consider splitting VoC logic and static LA data into separate modules.
Static LA_NEIGHBORHOODS + RESTAURANTS are in-memory Python constants. Fine for MVP; if/when the dataset grows, move to MongoDB seed.
VoC uses polite fallback defaults when Gemini returns no JSON — verified, graceful.
Gemini model retry chain (gemini-2.5-flash → flash-lite → flash-latest) with 503/429/UNAVAILABLE/overload handling is implemented correctly.
Frontend Login.jsx testid is 'login-submit-button' while the review-request wording referenced 'login-submit-btn'. Current implementation is fine; just a doc/naming consistency note.
Playbook items in MarketingInsights.jsx render without data-testid per item — not critical; page-insights testid is sufficient for the requested validation.
seed_data_creation: VoC history was populated via the 2 VoC sync tests (Bestia + LA-wide default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_qlub_api.py covers all 6 backend endpoints including the Gemini-grounded VoC flow. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_qlub_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. VoC test takes ~20-40s due to Gemini call. Frontend data-testid names confirmed: login-submit-button (not login-submit-btn), all page-*, nav-*, kpi-*, icp-attr-0..5, icp-persona, icp-anti, expo-card-<id>, expo-search, expo-filter-pos/hood/inv, expo-detail-modal/close, export-pdf-btn, export-xlsx-btn, voc-target-input, voc-run-sync-btn, voc-staged-banner, voc-discard-btn, voc-promote-btn, toggle-sync-lock-btn, sync-lock-chip, logout-button.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. App is green.
